Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly stated that Bamboo Mañalac was only confirmed as a singer and “not yet confirmed as a musician” due to no instrument being indicated, despite the cited source explicitly describing him as a “Filipino musician, singer, and songwriter.” This conflated “musician” with “instrumentalist” and ignored that singers are musicians, leading to unnecessary doubt and redundant searches.
